cues.en: Mike: In this video, I'm going to teach you a method for identifying outliers.
cues.zh: Mike：這部影片要教你一種辨識離群值的方法。

cues.en: It is based on the super important ubiquitous Z-score method that you have already learned about.
cues.zh: 它以你已經學過、極其重要且廣泛使用的 Z 分數方法為基礎。

cues.en: So let's begin.
cues.zh: 我們開始吧。

cues.en: This is just a really quick reminder of the Z-score.
cues.zh: 先非常快速地複習 Z 分數。

cues.en: So to compute a Z-score, you take each data point, you subtract the mean across the dataset, and you divide by the standard deviation.
cues.zh: 計算 Z 分數時，從每個資料點減去整組資料的平均值，再除以標準差。

cues.en: And then, so let's see.
cues.zh: 然後，看看。

cues.en: So you mean-center and standard-deviation normalize, and then the interpretation of the Z-score is that it is in standard deviation units away from the center of the distribution.
cues.zh: 也就是平均中心化，再以標準差正規化；Z 分數代表距離分布中心有多少個標準差。

cues.en: And Z-scores are appropriate to apply as a transform of your data if the data are roughly normally distributed.
cues.zh: 如果資料大致呈常態分布，Z 分數就適合作為資料轉換。

cues.en: So if they kind of approach a Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 也就是大致接近高斯分布。

cues.en: If that is not the case, if you have data that are really strongly non-Gaussian, you can use what's called the modified Z-score.
cues.zh: 如果不是，資料嚴重偏離高斯分布，可以使用所謂的修正 Z 分數。

cues.en: I'm going to introduce you to that in the next video.
cues.zh: 下一部影片會介紹。

cues.en: Okay, but so for now, we will assume that the Z-score is a valid, useful, appropriate transformation to apply to our data.
cues.zh: 目前先假設，Z 分數是適用於我們資料的有效、有用、合適的轉換。

cues.en: Okay, so here's the idea.
cues.zh: 好，概念是這樣。

cues.en: Here's the algorithm.
cues.zh: 演算法如下。

cues.en: Fairly straightforward.
cues.zh: 相當直接。

cues.en: You can convert your data to Z-score and then you identify some threshold, a standard deviation threshold, a threshold of three is fairly typical,
cues.zh: 先將資料轉換成 Z 分數，再設定一個門檻，也就是標準差門檻，設為 3 相當常見，

cues.en: but it's a bit arbitrary, it's a bit subjective.
cues.zh: 但這有一點任意性，也有一點主觀。

cues.en: I'll talk about that a little bit more in a moment.
cues.zh: 等一下會多談一點。

cues.en: Okay, and then any data point or data points that exceed that standard deviation threshold are labeled as outliers and removed from the data.
cues.zh: 接著，任何超過標準差門檻的資料點，都標記為離群值，並從資料中移除。

cues.en: So here is our original data.
cues.zh: 這裡是原始資料。

cues.en: These are just the data points sorted in the order in which the data was acquired.
cues.zh: 資料點只是按照擷取資料的先後順序排列。

cues.en: So this is not a meaningful data dimension.
cues.zh: 所以這不是有意義的資料維度。

cues.en: This is our main data variable.
cues.zh: 這裡才是主要的資料變數。

cues.en: And it's already pretty obvious that these are the two data points that we are going to remove.
cues.zh: 已經很明顯，我們會移除這兩個資料點。

cues.en: Okay, so this is the original scale.
cues.zh: 這是原始尺度。

cues.en: Whatever this scale means doesn't really matter.
cues.zh: 不管這個尺度代表什麼，都不重要。

cues.en: And now what we do is step one, convert these data into Z-score.
cues.zh: 現在進行第一步，將資料轉換成 Z 分數。

cues.en: So remember, the Z-score method is a lossless transformation of the data.
cues.zh: 記住，Z 分數方法是無損資料轉換。

cues.en: So we're not changing the shape of the data, we're not changing the relationships across the different data points.
cues.zh: 不會改變資料形狀，也不會改變不同資料點之間的關係。

cues.en: All we're changing is the scale of the data.
cues.zh: 只會改變資料的尺度。

cues.en: So now we have standard deviation units instead of whatever this original scale was.
cues.zh: 因此現在使用標準差單位，取代原本的尺度。

cues.en: Now, one thing I would like to mention here is that even if you have strictly positive data, which we don't have here actually, some of these data points are negative, but even if you have strictly positive data,
cues.zh: 這裡想提一點：即使資料嚴格為正，雖然這裡其實不是，有些資料點是負的，但即使資料嚴格為正，

cues.en: you can still get, or you will still get, negative Z-score values.
cues.zh: 仍可能，或仍然會得到負的 Z 分數。

cues.en: Now, whether or not that is awkward to interpret depends on your application, but just something to keep in mind.
cues.zh: 這是否難以解讀，要看應用，只是提醒你記住。

cues.en: Okay, so then we say that this is our threshold of three standard deviation units.
cues.zh: 好，接著設定三個標準差的門檻。

cues.en: And so these datapoints exceed our threshold, and so we label them as outliers and remove them.
cues.zh: 這些資料點超過門檻，所以標記為離群值並移除。

cues.en: Now you can see that this threshold is a little bit arbitrary.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這個門檻有一點任意性。

cues.en: There's some subjectivity that comes in here.
cues.zh: 其中帶有一些主觀判斷。

cues.en: For one thing, why did I pick three and not 2.9 or 3.17?
cues.zh: 例如，為什麼選 3，而不是 2.9 或 3.17？

cues.en: We could have gone with a Z-score threshold of pi, 3.14, or if we had gone with a a Z-score threshold of four,
cues.zh: 可以把 Z 分數門檻設為 π，也就是 3.14；或者如果設為 4，

cues.en: then probably neither of these would be considered as outliers.
cues.zh: 這兩個可能都不會被視為離群值。

cues.en: Or if these datapoints were just a tiny bit smaller, they could have been 2.9, maybe this one is 2.87, and then they still look like outliers,
cues.zh: 或者，如果這些資料點只小一點點，可能是 2.9，也許這個是 2.87，它們看起來仍像離群值，

cues.en: but we might not remove them based on this threshold.
cues.zh: 但根據這個門檻，就可能不會移除。

cues.en: So there is some subjectivity.
cues.zh: 所以有主觀性。

cues.en: It's just something you have to keep in mind and be mindful of.
cues.zh: 必須記住並留意這件事。

cues.en: What's often ends up being done is that you will look at the data and come up with an appropriate threshold based on some initial inspection of the data.
cues.zh: 常見做法是，先檢視資料，再根據初步觀察決定適當門檻。

cues.en: Okay, so this is the basic algorithm.
cues.zh: 好，這就是基本演算法。

cues.en: It can actually be extended to something called the iterative Z-score algorithm.
cues.zh: 它其實可以延伸成所謂的迭代 Z 分數演算法。

cues.en: So let me explain that to you now.
cues.zh: 現在來說明。

cues.en: So you notice now I'm just flipping back and forth between these two slides.
cues.zh: 注意，我只是在這兩張投影片之間來回切換。

cues.en: So step one and step two are identical.
cues.zh: 第一步和第二步完全相同。

cues.en: So we're doing the same thing.
cues.zh: 做的是一樣的事。

cues.en: The main reason why this is called iterative is after you remove the outliers, you then repeat steps one and two on the data without the outliers,
cues.zh: 稱為迭代，主要是因為移除離群值後，會對不包含這些離群值的資料，再次執行第一步和第二步，

cues.en: and you keep repeating steps one and two, successively iteratively removing more and more data until no more outliers are detected.
cues.zh: 不斷重複這兩步，逐次、迭代地移除越來越多資料，直到不再偵測到離群值。

cues.en: So here we see an example of this.
cues.zh: 這裡有個例子。

cues.en: This graph looks a little bit confusing.
cues.zh: 這張圖看起來有點令人困惑。

cues.en: So let me take a moment to walk you through what we're looking at here.
cues.zh: 我花一點時間說明這裡在看什麼。

cues.en: So what I've done is create a data set that contains some number of outliers.
cues.zh: 我先建立一組含有若干離群值的資料。

cues.en: And then I went through and did the Z-score method that I just described.
cues.zh: 然後執行剛才介紹的 Z 分數方法。

cues.en: So convert the data to Z-score, that's what you see on the Y axis, and come up with a threshold.
cues.zh: 把資料轉成 Z 分數，也就是 Y 軸顯示的數值，再設定門檻。

cues.en: So the first loop, the first time I went through steps one and two, that gave me the data in these greenish bluish triangles here.
cues.zh: 第一輪，也就是第一次執行第一步和第二步，得到這些偏綠藍色三角形的資料。

cues.en: So this, this light green triangle, these are the the first pass through this algorithm, and that identified one outlier up here.
cues.zh: 所以這些淡綠色三角形，是演算法第一次執行的結果，找出了上面這個離群值。

cues.en: So you can see it had a Z-score value of around five.
cues.zh: 可以看到，它的 Z 分數約為 5。

cues.en: So I plotted here with an X because I removed this from the data.
cues.zh: 這裡畫成 X，因為已經把它從資料中移除。

cues.en: Now, after I removed this one point from the data, that's step three, I went back to step one and converted the data to Z-score again.
cues.zh: 移除這個點後，也就是第三步，再回到第一步，重新將資料轉換成 Z 分數。

cues.en: But now the Z-score transformation is not going to be the same.
cues.zh: 但這次的 Z 分數轉換不會一樣。

cues.en: It's going to be a little bit different because we are now missing an outlier.
cues.zh: 會有些不同，因為現在少了一個離群值。

cues.en: In fact, you already know that the mean and the standard deviation are both influenced by outliers.
cues.zh: 事實上，你已經知道，平均值和標準差都會受到離群值影響。

cues.en: So the mean got artificially pulled up and the standard deviation also became larger because of the inclusion of this data point.
cues.zh: 包含這個資料點，會將平均值人為拉高，標準差也變大。

cues.en: So we exclude this data point and we compute the Z-score.
cues.zh: 所以排除這個資料點，再計算 Z 分數。

cues.en: Again, that gives us iteration two, which are these orange triangles.
cues.zh: 得到第二次迭代，也就是這些橘色三角形。

cues.en: And now there's an interesting thing.
cues.zh: 現在有件有趣的事。

cues.en: These orange triangles now revealed two additional outliers that were not outliers in the first iteration.
cues.zh: 這些橘色三角形又揭露了兩個離群值，在第一次迭代中，它們還不是離群值。

cues.en: So in the first iteration, the threshold, all of these points were lower.
cues.zh: 第一次迭代時，相對於門檻，這些點全都比較低。

cues.en: So this data point here at iteration two was this data point here at iteration one.
cues.zh: 第二次迭代中的這個資料點，就是第一次迭代中的這個點。

cues.en: Now I set a threshold of two standard deviations here that is admittedly a threshold that is probably too liberal for real data sets.
cues.zh: 這裡把門檻設為兩個標準差，必須承認，對真實資料集而言，這個門檻可能太寬鬆。

cues.en: You probably don't want to have an actual Z-score threshold of two, but I just set the threshold to be two here because basically I wanted to, I wanted to make sure we'd still get
cues.zh: 實際上大概不會想把 Z 分數門檻設為 2；這裡這麼設，基本上只是想確保第二次迭代時，仍能找到

cues.en: a couple of outliers on the second iteration, so I would have something to show you.
cues.zh: 幾個離群值，這樣才有東西可以展示。

cues.en: Okay, but nonetheless, the principle is important.
cues.zh: 不過，原理還是很重要。

cues.en: So then I removed these two outliers because now they weren't outliers in the first iteration.
cues.zh: 接著移除這兩個離群值，雖然它們在第一次迭代還不是離群值。

cues.en: They became outliers, they became super threshold in the second iteration.
cues.zh: 到了第二次迭代，才變成離群值、超過門檻。

cues.en: And then I repeated this again, I converted the data to Z-score, and that gave me iteration three, which are these yellow triangles, and not a single data point on iteration three
cues.zh: 然後再重複一次，把資料轉成 Z 分數，得到第三次迭代，也就是黃色三角形，而第三次迭代中沒有任何一個資料點

cues.en: was beyond this threshold of two standard deviations.
cues.zh: 超過兩個標準差的門檻。

cues.en: So then I stopped and that was the end.
cues.zh: 所以就停止，到此結束。

cues.en: So now we remove these three data points.
cues.zh: 現在移除了這三個資料點。

cues.en: Now, I have to say I'm not a huge fan of this iterative Z-score outlier detection method, because this is often the effect that you'll find
cues.zh: 必須說，我不太喜歡這種迭代 Z 分數離群值偵測方法，因為經常會出現這種效果：

cues.en: that there are data points that are kind of towards the edge of the distribution, but not really outliers.
cues.zh: 有些資料點只是比較靠近分布邊緣，其實不算離群值。

cues.en: They're not really so unusual or non-representative.
cues.zh: 它們並沒有那麼不尋常或不具代表性。

cues.en: They're just a little bit on the edge.
cues.zh: 只是稍微靠邊。

cues.en: And over the course of several iterations, they can actually be removed even if you don't think that they should be removed.
cues.zh: 經過幾次迭代，即使你認為不該移除，它們仍可能真的被移除。

cues.en: So this is the sort of thing that can happen more often with this iterative method compared to just the one shot method.
cues.zh: 相較於只執行一次的方法，迭代方法更容易發生這種情況。

cues.en: So, but that said, this is actually a great method and it's used all the time in data cleaning to identify and eliminate outliers.
cues.zh: 話雖如此，這其實是很好的方法，也經常用於資料清理，辨識並排除離群值。

cues.en: Now, one thing I forgot to mention, so I'll make sure I say this explicitly.
cues.zh: 有一點剛才忘了提，這裡要明確說明。

cues.en: I'm here showing only positive sides.
cues.zh: 這裡只展示正值側。

cues.en: So just positive standard deviations.
cues.zh: 也就是正的標準差方向。

cues.en: So data points that are extreme on the right side of the tail, so above the mean.
cues.zh: 也就是右尾的極端資料點，高於平均值的那些。

cues.en: But of course, in practice, depending on the nature of your data, it's likely that you'll want to apply this to the negative side as well.
cues.zh: 但實務上，視資料性質而定，很可能也需要套用到負值側。

cues.en: So you would say any datapoints that are above three, above plus three standard deviations or below minus three standard deviations,
cues.zh: 也就是說，任何高於 3、高於正三個標準差，或低於負三個標準差的資料點，

cues.en: those should be removed from the data.
cues.zh: 都應該從資料中移除。

cues.en: Okay, so in this video I told you about the Z-score method for identifying and removing outliers.
cues.zh: 好，這部影片介紹了使用 Z 分數來辨識並移除離群值的方法。

cues.en: There is the one shot method and the iterative method.
cues.zh: 有單次方法，也有迭代方法。

cues.en: And although I generally don't recommend using the iterative method, I'm sure there are particular cases out there where it is appropriate.
cues.zh: 雖然我通常不建議使用迭代方法，但相信某些特定情況下，它確實適用。

cues.en: Nonetheless, I think it's good for you to know about this method and to see how it works.
cues.zh: 不過，我認為知道這個方法並了解它如何運作，對你仍然有幫助。

cues.en: In the next video, I'm going to explain how to modify this Z-score method for when you have data that do not conform to a normal distribution.
cues.zh: 下一部影片會說明，當資料不符合常態分布時，如何修改這個 Z 分數方法。

cues.en: See you soon.
cues.zh: 待會見。
